primitives.name: Offensive Line Partition
primitives.verbatim_quote: All-New Jersey Shore Scholastic Eleven (Newark Sunday Call)—Ends, Coles (Chattle) and Vola (Asbury Park); tackles, Capabianca (Neptune) and Brown (Asbury Park); guards, Grossman (Asbury Park) and Mullen (Chattle); center, Moren (Atlantic Highlands); quarter-back, Major (Lakewood); half-backs, Pear (Asbury Park) and Hauser (Atlantic Highlands); full-back, Gifford (Neptune).
primitives.assumptions: Players form a fixed partition of the offensive line; each role has deterministic influence on game state.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When positional roles overlap or player availability is insufficient.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a bipartite graph where players are nodes and roles define edges; G ∪ C → Q ∪ HB ∪ FB defines a partitioned action space.
layer2.telemetry: Player role assignment consistency across regional selections.

primitives.name: Regional Selection Vector
primitives.verbatim_quote: All-Central New Jersey Scholastic Eleven (Newark Sunday Call)-Ends, Hinchman (Bordentown) and McCabe (Trenton); tackles, Ketterer (Trenton) and Van Note Pennington); guards, Scott (New Brunswick) and Bridgewater (Trenton); center, Hensler (Princeton); quarter-back, Mealey (Trenton); half-backs, Hackett (Trenton) and Morris (New Brunswick); full-back, J.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R': 'region identifier', 'P_i': 'player i from region R', 'S': 'selection vector over P_i'}
primitives.assumptions: Each region contributes a unique subset of players based on local performance metrics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When selection criteria vary by region or player pool shrinks.

layer2.mapping: Kernel function maps regional performance data to player selection probability; S(R) = Σ P_i ∈ R w_i * f(P_i)
layer2.telemetry: Cross-regional variance in selected player quality indices.

primitives.name: Team Composition Matrix
primitives.verbatim_quote: Louis Scholastic Eleven (by George Henger)—Ends, Nies (Central) and Davis (Soldan); taekles, Krenzer (McKinley) and Walsh (Soldan); guards, Anderson (Soldan) and Mohr (McKinley); center, Mechin (Soldan); quarter-back, Merstetter (Oentral); half-backs, Johnson (Soldan) and Baum (Manual); full-back, Shanley (Yeatman).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'M': 'matrix of player assignments', 'm_ij': 'player j in role i', 'R_i': 'role set i'}
primitives.assumptions: Matrix entries represent fixed positional assignments; roles are mutually exclusive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When matrix rank drops due to duplicate or missing player-role mappings.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a permutation matrix over player-role pairs; M = [m_ij] such that ∑ m_ij = 1 for all i,j.
layer2.telemetry: Rank deficiency in player-role assignment matrices across teams.

The offensive line partition (offensive_line_partition) reflects a bipartite structure where guards and center form a static front against opposing defensive lines, while the quarterback and backfield roles define dynamic execution paths. Regional selection vectors (regional_selection_vector) encode how local performance metrics map into broader team compositions, suggesting a kernel-based aggregation of regional talent pools. Team composition matrices (team_composition_matrix) formalize these structures as discrete mappings between players and roles, enabling analysis of team balance and strategic flexibility. Dualities emerge in the symmetry between offensive and defensive positioning, and failure modes include role ambiguity, incomplete coverage, or over-reliance on singular players. These operators support a mathematical framework for analyzing team dynamics through combinatorial and algebraic lenses.
